pv22:1.1: [FOOTNOTES] Divāvihāragataṃ bhikkhuṃ Gaṅgātīre nisinnakaṃ taṃ petī upasaṅkamma dubbaṇṇā bhīrudassanā, || ||
pv22:2.1: Kesā c' assā atidīghā yāva bhūmāvalambare Kesehi sā paṭicchannā samaṇaṃ etad abravī: || ||
pv22:3.1: Pañcapaṇṇāsavassāni yato kālakatā ahaṃ nābhijānāmi bhuttaṃ vā pītaṃ vā pana pāniyaṃ dehi tvaṃ pāniyaṃ bhante tasitā pāniyāya me ti. || ||
pv22:4.1: Ayaṃ sītodikā Gaṅgā Himavantato sandati Piva etto gahetvāna kiṃ maṃ yācasi pāniyaṃ. || || Sacāhaṃ
pv22:5.1: bhante Gaṅgāya sayaṃ gaṇhāmi pāniyaṃ lohitaṃ me parivattati tasmā yācāmi pāniyaṃ. || || Kin
pv22:6.1: nu kāyena vācāya manasā dukkaṭaṃ kataṃ kissa kammavipākena Gaṅgā te hoti lohitaṃ. || || Putto
pv22:7.1: me Uttaro nāma saddho āsi upāsako so ca mayhaṃ akāmāya samaṇānaṃ pavecchati
pv22:8.1: cīvaraṃ piṇḍapātañ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ. || || Tam ahaṃ paribbhāsāmi maccherena upaddutā:
pv22:9.1: yaṃ tvaṃ mayhaṃ akāmāya samaṇānaṃ pavecchasi cīvaraṃ piṇḍapātañ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ, || ||
pv22:10.1: Etaṃ te paralokasmiṃ lohitaṃ hotu Uttara tassa kammavipākena Gaṅgā me hoti lohitan ti. || ||
